rows.name: TRON_INGEST_PLUGIN_BUNDLE

cells.Set by: A developer with a prebuilt bundle. The Nix test build exports it.
cells.Values and default: Path of a plugin bundle (a directory with `manifest.json` and C++ model headers that ingest generated). `make TRON_INGEST_PLUGIN_BUNDLE=path` also works. Unset: `make` passes an empty value to CMake, and the build generates the model headers with ingest.

rows.name: TRON_INGEST_PLUGIN_BUNDLE_STAMP_REQUIRED

cells.Values and default: Only the text `1` turns the stamp update on. Any other text counts as off. Unset: `make` sets `1` when no goal is given, or when a goal is outside its list of goals that do not use the bundle.

rows.name: TRON_FEATURE_BRANCH_BUILD

cells.Set by: CI workflow `publish-deb.yml`, with `1` on feature branches.
cells.Values and default: Any text that is not empty turns it on. `0` and `false` also turn it on. Unset: off. On a branch other than `main` and `release-*` the version is `<YYYY.MM.DD>-<8-character commit hash>-<branch>`, or the tag of `HEAD` when one exists.
cells.Effect: On a named branch other than `main` and `release-*`, `bin/get-version.sh` prints `<tag without v>+feature.<branch>.<commits since the tag>.g<8-character commit hash>`. The tag is the nearest reachable tag that matches `v[0-9]*`. The script exits with code 1 when no such tag exists or the tag does not have the version form. A version tag is `v<numbers with dots>` with an optional `-devN`, `-tcN` or `-rcN`. It has no effect on `main`, `release-*` branches and a detached `HEAD`. `bin/make-version.sh` compiles the printed version into the programs. `bin/get-deb-version.sh` writes `+feature.` as `~feature.` in the Debian package version.
